notes.title: Middle Age Conquest - Release Announcement
notes.content:
First of all thanks for reading this announcement, this is very exciting moment for me, tomorrow my game "Middle Age Conquest" will be released. I want to thank all of the people who wishlist and help my game . Even "Middle Age Conquest" isn't deep and complex game, I hope it will make people who love this genre interested in it.


Techinical And Gameplay Stuff :

* 3 Different Language (English - Turkish - Deutsche ).

* Different Flag Abilities For Different Groups.

* Resource Managment And Upgradable Materials.

* Pleasant Main Hub (I Hope You Like It Too).

* 24 Various Quest With Various Rewards For Each.

* 17 Different Kingdoms You Can Fight.

* 20 Different Achievement For All Achievement Runners.
